author: GamingBolt
description:
Despite some issues, it’s difficult to deny that Dinoblade is fun. It’s the perfect level of cheesy to ensure that you’ll be smiling throughout, and the music and combat do much to keep the entire experience quite engaging. 

Sure, it won’t exactly set the world on fire with its simplistic approach to Soulslike combat and bland visual style. Ultimately, however, Dinoblade is plenty of fun, especially if you enjoy fast-paced combat that takes some of its cues from Soulslikes.
title: Dinoblade Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
We knew that Halo: Campaign Evolved would take things up a notch graphically compared to its predecessors. However, the risk of going too far and losing what made those titles special over the years has been too great to ignore. It’s a pitfall that has plagued every ambitious effort to usher a classic into a new era of gaming and a new generation of players. 

Well, Campaign has more riding on its shoulders than that, but regarding its visuals, it carries the weight of lofty expectations with style, grace, and a confidence stemming from a reverence for what made it special initially. Join us as we look at the graphical differences Campaign Evolved brings to the table and how they make it the definitive way to enjoy one of modern gaming’s masterpieces.
title: Halo Campaign Evolved Remake vs Anniversary Edition vs Original – 15 Biggest Graphical Differences

author: GamingBolt
description:
Halo: Campaign Evolved is here, and if you’re thinking about diving in, a lot has changed for the better. But those changes might not be immediately noticeable, leading you to miss out on some of the best new features introduced. 

That’s quite easy to do in a title where the action rarely lets up, and things slip by unnoticed in the heat of battle. That’s where we come in. We’ve spent a fair bit of time with this one and have a few things for you to remember as you step into the shoes of Master Chief to wreak havoc amongst enemy ranks and be a warrior who has turned the tides of many a battle in his many years of service.
title: Halo Campaign Evolved - 20 Things I Wish I KNEW BEFORE STARTING IT
